description: Issue #815: *one fault, one diagnostic* (`spec/execution-model.md:750-766`). An unresolvable callable has unknown arity, so `100` has no grammatical home and the reader raises `ol-bad-token` for it — but that token is not the fault, and the spec forbids reporting it "in its place or beside it". What survives is `ol-unknown-command` with the did-you-mean computed over the VISIBLE vocabulary, which is why `suggestion` is `forward` here: Turtle & Rendering is in this run's profile set. The sibling fixture under Core Language alone reports the same fault with no suggestion.
